summary: Orders the pixel span endpoints a1/a2 (swapping if a1 > a2 so the span runs ascending), then fills the 16-bit span starting at a1 + a5*a3 for a2 - a1 + 1 elements with value a4 using F_16BitShortArrayFill(a1 + a5*a3, a2 - a1 + 1, a4, a6). Returns the fill helper's result.

operations.description: If a1 > a2, swap a1 and a2 so the span endpoints are ascending (clamped ordering).
Compute destination pointer a1 + a5*a3 (start plus row_index * row_stride) and element count a2 - a1 + 1.
Call F_16BitShortArrayFill(a1 + a5*a3, a2 - a1 + 1, a4, a6) to fill the 16-bit span.
